title: Gulf of Mexico summer hypoxic 'dead zone' size (square miles)

source.name: Gulf of Mexico Hypoxia Survey
source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science (NCCOS) / LUMCON

notes: Annual mid-summer shelfwide survey has run since 1985. 2017 (8,776 sq mi) is the largest zone ever measured -- roughly the size of New Jersey. 2024's 6,705 sq mi was the 12th largest in 38 years of measurement, well above the 37-year historical average of 5,205 sq mi.
